---
title: "P-value with top genes"
---


## Load Packages

```{r}
#| label: load-packages
#| message: false
#| warning: false

# pacman::p_load()

conflicted::conflict_prefer_all("dplyr", quiet = TRUE)
```

## Load Data

### Set the top number of genes

```{r}
#| label: set-top-number
#| message: false

top_n <- 2000
```

### Get File Paths

```{r}
#| label: get-paths
#| message: false

source(here("custom_func/select_top_cg.R"))
annot <- read_rds(here("data/upon_request/annotated_asso_wide.rds"))

# Dementia transition categories
demcats <- c("mci2incid", "normal2incid", "normal2mci", "prev", "stable_mci") |>
  set_names()

demcats
```


### Read the data

```{r}
#| label: read-data
#| message: false

sig_cpg_data <- demcats |>
  imap_dfr(~ select_top_cg(annot, .y, top_n) |>
   # Keep only the cg and the p-value for the current demcat
   select(cg, all_of(glue::glue("nlog10_p_value_{.y}"))) |>
   # Rename the p-value column to nlog10_p_value
   rename(nlog10_p_value = all_of(glue::glue("nlog10_p_value_{.y}"))),
   .id = "demcat") |>
   # Relevel demcat
   mutate(demcat = fct_relevel(demcat, "normal2mci", "stable_mci", "normal2incid", "mci2incid", "prev"))

glimpse(sig_cpg_data)
```

## Create a new column for the gene rank

```{r}
#| label: create-gene-rank
#| message: false

sig_cpg_rank <- sig_cpg_data |>
  group_by(demcat) |>
  arrange(desc(nlog10_p_value), .by_group = TRUE) |>
  mutate(gene_rank = row_number()) |>
  ungroup()

glimpse(sig_cpg_rank)
```

## Number of DMPs

```{r}
#| label: number-of-dmp
#| message: false

number_of_dmp <- sig_cpg_rank |>
  group_by(demcat) |>
  summarise(n = sum(nlog10_p_value > 8)) |>
  mutate(
    x = 500,
    y = 8.5,
    label = glue::glue("{n} CpGs")
  )

number_of_dmp
```

## Select points to display their p-values

```{r}
#| label: select-points-to-display
#| message: false

pval_to_display <- sig_cpg_rank |>
  filter(gene_rank %in% c(1, 1000, 2000))

pval_to_display
```

## Plot the p-value with top genes


```{r}
#| label: plot-pval-with-top-genes
#| message: false
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 8

plot_pval_with_top_genes <- sig_cpg_rank |>
  ggplot(aes(x = gene_rank, y = nlog10_p_value)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_point(data = pval_to_display, color = "darkred", shape = 18, size = 5) +
  geom_text(data = pval_to_display, aes(label = round(nlog10_p_value, 2)),
            hjust = 0.5, vjust = -1.5, color = "darkred", size = 12 / .pt) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 8, linetype = "dashed", color = "steelblue") +
  # Add text annotation for p-value threshold
  annotate("label", x = 1200, y = 8,
        #    label = "1.0 %*% 10^{-8}~(threshold)",
           label = "1.0 %*% 10^{-8}",
           parse = TRUE,
           hjust = 0,
           vjust = 0.5,
           size = 12 / .pt,
           fill = "steelblue",
           colour = "white",
           fontface = "bold") +
  geom_text(data = number_of_dmp, aes(x = x, y = y, label = label),
             hjust = 0, vjust = 0.5, color = "steelblue", size = 12 / .pt) +
  facet_wrap(~demcat, ncol = 3, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.15))) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.1, 0.1))) +
  labs(x = "Top gene number", y = "-log10(p-value)")

plot_pval_with_top_genes
```

## Save the plot

```{r}
#| label: save-plot
#| message: false

fs::dir_create(here("pathway_analysis/01_genes/output"))
write_rds(plot_pval_with_top_genes, here("pathway_analysis/01_genes/output/pval_with_top_genes_plot.rds"))

ggsave(
  here("pathway_analysis/01_genes/output/fig_sup_pval_with_top_genes_plot.png"),
  plot_pval_with_top_genes,
  width = 10,
  height = 8,
  dpi = 300,
  device = grDevices::png
)
```
